exception: RuntimeError: A visible workspace could not move keyboard focus with Tab
diagnosis: Native Xvfb has no window manager; the helper did not activate its mapped window, leaving activeWindow/focusWidget empty.
With the owned MainWindow explicitly active, Tab still remained at the professional-tools button: a visible QTabWidget retained a hidden QTabBar focus proxy.
A separate minimal two-button native Qt window moved focus correctly; this distinguished the actual product focus-chain defect from unavailable native keyboard events.

runtime_only_experiments.tabs_no_focus_only: TAB_MOVED_TO_workspaceNav2; Qt also propagated NoFocus to proxy bar

corrections.product: Root set the hidden tabs/tabBar to NoFocus and added actual navigation Tab regression.
corrections.helper: Explicit existing xdotool windowfocus --sync for the owned winId, bounded event processing before assertions.
